task.title: DEXA -> Apple Health writeback audit + implementation plan

result.summary: Audit + plan only. No body measurements are written to Apple Health today; PhysiqueOS Weight is manual-only, so DEXA writeback cannot contaminate PhysiqueOS Weight. Accepted point = active canonical DEXA after canonical_commit. Recommended V1: automatic prospective-only (scan date >= 2026-10-09) Native reconciler writing Body Fat % (+ Lean Body Mass as fat-free mass total-fat), sync-identifier exact-once/replace, own samples never re-ingested; do NOT write Weight/RMR/BMI. Founder decisions pending (7). Implementation not started.

static_audit.summary: Native e2cbcd0c + Server src (identical to d0ff6596 for DEXA/weight) + iOS 27.0 SDK headers; no builds/tests/production reads
